text: This report recommends that the name "Augusta Avenue" be approved to identify the new proposed road south of Dundas Street West, described as Block 3 on 66M-2582. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Augusta Avenue" to identify the new proposed road south of Dundas Street West, described as Block 3 on 66M-2582.
